Analysis of an ahmdir blue linen headscarf set with a segmented bronze scorpion pin indicates the creator has provided the following information:
---- Animalistic Spirit Headdresses ----
=General Script Information=
This is headgear with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.
The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing attacks against like-level foes, either magical or physical.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
If you also wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon, shield, or wear a set of associated armor, the infusion within the headscarf allows for all spirits to be tamed faster.
The spirit within the headscarf can be unlocked to allow it to morph into the appearance of the spirits within any other Animalistic Spirit item you are also bonded with.

In addition, the headscarf will draw out help from other wielded Animalistic Spirit gear when performing an Animalistic Avatar attack, adding Animalistic Fury (weapons/shields) or Animalistic Instinct (armor) to its attacks.

While wearing Animalistic Spirit armor, this headscarf will take the place of the associated head coverage (if the armor has no head coverage), or be appended to the head coverage's description (if the headscarf is not a helm/helmet) in the armor's messaging.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this headscarf are fine.
* Any merchant can change the adornment, adornment type, and how the adornment attaches to the headscarf.
Possible adornment types are: plain (color/texture), loose/dangling (feathers/tassels), reflective attachments (pins/gems/metal), rigid protrusions (spikes/horns), or designs (embroidery/etching).
* If the headscarf is NOT a helm/helmet, it is likely a merchant can change the headgear type.
Possible types are: headdresses, helms/helmets, tiara/circlets, crowns, headscarves/turbans, hats, or hoods.
* Customization of the line that shows up in your features when worn is also possible, but only the segment after the comma in the first sentence and the complete second sentence can be changed.
NOTE: This should NOT indicate movement, glowing, or anything other than a description of how the adornment looks on the headscarf when worn, or how the headscarf is being worn.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
Only the "main" spirit can be altered in this manner; any spirit imprints cannot be changed.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Feature-Worn
When worn, this headscarf can be viewable in your features, appearing just below the line indicating your race.  It is toggleable with TOUCH.
Feature-Worn ability is currently: ON [Toggle with TOUCH]
* Temporary Eye Feature Change
RUBbing the headscarf causes the spirit's essence to briefly infuse your eyes, turning them into "feral misty green eyes" for 4 hours.
* Animalistic Apparition = Locked

When unlocked, the headscarf gains the ability for a representation of the current spirit to appear after your inventory when people LOOK at you.  You can toggle this with SPIN, which can also change what mood the spirit will appear like to others.
* Spirit Imprints = Locked

When unlocked, the headscarf gains the ability to "imprint" with other spirits and morph into their appearance at will.  The spirit within the headscarf must be attuned to you, as well as the spirit of the other piece of Animalistic Spirit gear you are trying to imprint.

Use INSPECT to view any imprinted spirits, TURN to coax the spirit within the headscarf to morph into a different spirit appearance, CLEAN to remove a spirit imprint, and POINT the headscarf at the other item you want it to imprint to.
NOTE: You can only unlock a maximum of 4 extra slots for imprinted spirits on this headscarf.
* Animalistic Avatar = Unlocked [Tier 1 of 4]

When unlocked, gain access to a maneuver-based attack using WAVE that briefly turns you into the avatar of the attached spirit, potentially rooting the target to the spot in fear.  This can be unleashed every 6 minutes.
If the multi-opponent version is unlocked, the same attack can be unleashed on a maximum of 3 creatures in the room once an hour.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, or wear Animalistic Spirit armor, the respective item's flare will be added to the headscarf's attack.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 1 of 3)
At this tier, this headscarf captures the following: WEAR, REMOVE, RUB (Temporary Eye Change), TOUCH (Feature-worn On/Off).
Use PROD to make the spirit less visible while using these actions [Spirit is currently: Awake]
* Tameness/Affinity
Tame the spirit to prevent it enacting its rage upon you.
Only one person can have allegiance to this headscarf's spirit at a time.
The feeling of this spirit toward someone else is tame (Level 12 of 12).
NOTE: To switch this headscarf's allegiance to you, you must drop its tameness to the previous owner by damaging like-level creatures with physical or magical attacks.
